rules.headings: Use tight letter spacing (tracking-tighter) for massive headings. Weight contrast is key: use font-light for elegance or font-bold for impact. DO NOT USE INTER OR ROBOTO FOR HEADINGS.
rules.overlines: Uppercase, tiny, wide spacing (tracking-[0.2em]) for labels and categories.

rules.tints: Never use pure #000000 or #FFFFFF. Use #2A2624 for blacks and #FDFBF7 for whites.
rules.gradients: No generic digital gradients. Rely on flat earthy tones.
rules.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 ratio for text. Always explicitly set hover text colors.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use flat solid surfaces. Minimal glassmorphism to preserve the tactile, organic, and artisanal feel of candlemaking. Avoid 'tech' glows.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px delicate borders (border-[#E8E2D6]) to structure content instead of heavy drop shadows.
visual_enhancers.textures: Incorporate subtle grain overlays or SVG noise to break the digital flatness and evoke physical craft materials.

components.strategy: Hybrid: Use pure HTML/Tailwind for marketing/hero sections to achieve asymmetrical art direction. Use customized Shadcn for forms, dialogs, and interactive e-commerce logic.
components.buttons: Pill-shaped or sharp rectangular with subtle interaction animations. Use background-color shifts on hover (e.g., primary to primary_hover).
components.cards: Cardless where possible. Use generous whitespace and borders to delineate products rather than floating white boxes.
components.inputs: Use Shadcn inputs but override borders to match the earthy palette (border-[#E8E2D6]) and focus rings to #C86B4F.

grids.marketing: Use 'Bento' Mode A (Tetris Grid) for educational content and brand storytelling. Mix 3+ shapes (Hero, Square, Tall, Filler). Leave negative space.
grids.ecommerce: Spacious 2, 3, or 4 column grids for product catalogs (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3) with gap-8 to gap-12.
grids.rules: Grid items must be direct children. Override default stretch with align-items: start if needed.

layouts.spacing: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use 2-3x more spacing (p-12, p-16, p-24) to create a premium, calm, artisanal vibe.
layouts.alignment: Left-align paragraphs, inputs, and dense content for readability. Headings can be centered for editorial effect.
layouts.mobile: Mobile-first. Images must not exceed 80vh on mobile.

motion.libraries: framer-motion for interactions. lenis for premium smooth momentum scrolling.
motion.rules: Subtle entrance animations for product lists (staggered fade-up). Image hover reveals (slight scale up of image within overflow-hidden container). Disable/reduce animations for prefers-reduced-motion.

accessibility.contrast: Meet APCA or WCAG AA minimum 4.5:1 for normal text.
accessibility.focus: High contrast focus states for all interactive elements.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case based on role (e.g., data-testid='add-to-cart-button').

media.icons: Use @phosphor-icons/react (Duotone or Light weight) for an elegant, high-end feel.
media.images: Use realistic, high-quality artisanal imagery. Avoid placeholders.

3d_libraries.decision: Not required for MVP, rely on high-quality 2D photography and Framer Motion for parallax to maintain the artisanal, organic aesthetic. (No R3F needed unless adding a 3D candle customizer in the future).

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required dependencies: framer-motion, @phosphor-icons/react, lenis, sonner.
Implement Google Auth & JWT Email/Password for the backend.
Create a browsable E-commerce catalog with search & filter, and a mock checkout flow.
Develop the Educational content section (Candle-making methods, recipes, tools list) using editorial, asymmetric layouts (Phase 1).
Use 'Cormorant Garamond' for headings. Never use Inter or standard sans-serif for H1/H2.
Do not use transparent headers without a backdrop blur or solid backing.
Integrate provided image_urls for categories and features. Do not use dummy placeholders.
Ensure the e-commerce structure has a robust database schema for products, categories, orders, and users.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and overlap.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, i.e. do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
GENERAL_UI_UX_DESIGN_GUIDELINES: Mobile-first responsive design is strictly required.
Optical alignment over geometrical alignment (e.g., adjust padding for rounded icons).
Ensure content must be visible with increased contrast on :hover/:active/:focus.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute for testing.
Do not use complete transparent background in header, overlays, or any surface that has content under it.
Customize scrollbars to match the earthy theme; NO native gutter.
Use HTML/Tailwind over Shadcn 'Card' for highly custom editorial marketing sections to maintain creative freedom.
